# Wingtics

Provider-agnostic analytics widgets for React. One query model, six connectors — five
providers plus a deterministic mock — and the same dashboard behind all of them.

Site: https://wingtics.com
Repo: https://github.com/educlopez/wingtics
Docs: https://wingtics.com/docs
Components: https://wingtics.com/components
About: https://wingtics.com/about
Contact: https://wingtics.com/contact
Privacy: https://wingtics.com/privacy
License: MIT

## When to use this

Reach for Wingtics when a task is one of these:

- Build or extend an analytics dashboard in a React or Next.js app, where the data lives in
  Vercel Web Analytics, Plausible, Google Analytics 4, Umami or PostHog.
- Read website metrics without writing against one vendor's API, or migrate a dashboard from
  one of those providers to another without rewriting the charts.
- Add a specific chart — funnel, cohort grid, globe, sankey, treemap, breakdown card, metric
  tabs — to an existing analytics view, either as an npm import or as owned source via the
  shadcn registry.
- Keep analytics credentials off the client: `@wingtics/next` proxies a connector from a route
  handler so the token stays on the server.
- Build a dashboard that degrades honestly across providers: connectors declare capabilities,
  and a widget the provider cannot answer says so instead of rendering zero.

Do not reach for Wingtics when:

- You need to *collect* analytics. It has no tracker, no script and no ingest endpoint; it only
  reads what a provider already holds.
- You want a hosted dashboard. There is no service, no account and no API of ours to call —
  it is a component library you deploy yourself.
- Your data is product analytics in a warehouse rather than website analytics behind one of the
  five supported providers. Writing a connector is possible, but there is no adapter to reuse.

How to call it: install the packages below, construct one connector, wrap the tree in
`AnalyticsProvider`, and render either `Dashboard` for the whole grid or individual components.
Everything is typed; `useQuery` and `useCapabilities` are the two hooks worth knowing.

## Machine-readable

- https://wingtics.com/llms.txt — this file
- https://wingtics.com/sitemap.xml — every page
- https://wingtics.com/openapi.json — the HTTP surface: the component registry and the
  analytics proxy contract, with operation ids, typed schemas and error codes
- https://wingtics.com/r/registry.json — shadcn registry index
- https://wingtics.com/r/{name}.json — one registry item
- https://wingtics.com/api/v1/analytics — the analytics proxy this site runs against its
  own traffic. GET describes the connector and its capabilities; POST runs a query.

## API versioning and limits

Pin `/api/v1/`. A change that breaks a caller becomes `/api/v2/`; the previous major keeps
answering for at least 6 months from the day its successor ships, and carries
`Deprecation: true` and a `Sunset` date on every response from that day. Additive changes
happen in place, so parse defensively.

`/api/analytics`, unversioned, is an alias that always tracks the newest major. It is not
deprecated and is not going away — it is simply the wrong thing to pin, because it moves.

Every response carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset` and
`RateLimit-Policy`, so pace yourself before being refused rather than after. Over budget
answers 429 with `Retry-After` and `"code": "RATE_LIMIT"`. The limit is 60 requests per 60
seconds per client address, counted per serving instance — treat it as a floor you can rely
on, not a quota metered exactly.

The index and the component pages also answer `Accept: text/markdown` with a markdown
representation of the same content, and send `Vary: Accept` so a cache cannot mix the two:

```bash
curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://wingtics.com/components/globe-chart
```

## Install

```bash
pnpm add @wingtics/react @wingtics/core @wingtics/next @wingtics/connector-vercel
```

Also: `@wingtics/connector-plausible`, `connector-ga4`, `connector-umami`, `connector-posthog`, `connector-mock`. Import `@wingtics/react/styles.css` once.

Keep vendor tokens on the server. The browser talks to your own route — this site serves one at `/api/v1/analytics` — via `createHttpConnector`.

## Provider

```tsx
import { AnalyticsProvider, Dashboard } from "@wingtics/react";
import { createVercelConnector } from "@wingtics/connector-vercel";
import "@wingtics/react/styles.css";

const connector = createVercelConnector({
  token: process.env.VERCEL_TOKEN!,
  projectId: process.env.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID!,
});

export function Stats() {
  return (
    <AnalyticsProvider connector={connector} theme="light" range="7d">
      <Dashboard />
    </AnalyticsProvider>
  );
}
```

Server route: `createRouteHandlers({ connector })` from `@wingtics/next`.

## Query model

Widgets never send vendor field names. They send a canonical `AnalyticsQuery`:

```ts
await connector.query({
  range: "7d",
  metrics: ["visitors", "pageviews"],
  dimensions: ["path"],
  granularity: "day",
  limit: 8,
  includePrevious: true,
});
```

Result: `totals`, `series`, `breakdown`, optional `previous.totals`. Hooks: `useQuery`, `useRealtime`, `useCapabilities`. If a connector cannot answer a metric, the widget renders an unsupported state.

## Charts

`variant` is the drawing, not a color theme. Colors inherit `--chart-1`…`--chart-5` from the host.

- AreaChart — gradient, linear, natural, step, dots, spark, dither, glow, hatched, bars, solid
- LineChart — monotone, linear, step, dashed, dots, dither, glow, ping, rainbow, values
- BarChart — vertical, horizontal, rounded, hatched, dither, glow, gradient, duotone
- PieChart — donut, pie, legend, dither, rounded, radial, glow
- FunnelChart — tape, steps, vertical
- RadarChart — stroke, fill, glow, dither
- ComposedChart — combo, highlight, overlay
- GaugeChart — arc, ring, tick
- ScatterChart — dots, bubble, glow
- SankeyChart — flow, gradient, dither (nodes + links)
- CandlestickChart — ohlc, hollow, wick
- ChoroplethChart — tiles, heat, dither (region tiles, not a geoJSON map)
- LiveLineChart — stream, glow, dashed
- RingChart — stack, nested, track
- HeatmapChart — calendar, matrix, dither
- SunburstChart — nest, burst
- ProfitLossChart — fill, stroke, bars
- MetricCard — default, spark, compact, hero
- RankedList — bar, compact, table

Shared chart props: `data`, `dataKey`, `labelKey`, `variant`, `config`, `className`.

## Widgets

`Dashboard` lays out registered widgets. `defaultDashboard` is the Vercel-friendly subset. `catalogDashboard` is every built-in.

Ids: visitors, pageviews, visits, events, bounce-rate, duration, views-per-visit, realtime, timeseries, top-pages, top-referrers, top-countries, devices, top-browsers, top-os, top-sources, top-campaigns, top-events, pages-table, tracker.

## Colors

No kit theme pack. Set host CSS variables:

```css
:root {
  --chart-1: #1d779b;
  --chart-2: #297c3b;
  --chart-3: #c45c26;
  --chart-4: #7c6a4a;
  --chart-5: #5b4a8a;
  --card: #fff;
  --foreground: #1a1613;
  --primary: #1d779b;
  --border: #e3ddcf;
}
```

## shadcn registry

```bash
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://wingtics.com/r/dashboard.json
```

Every catalog chart plus `metric-card` and `dashboard`. GitHub: `educlopez/wingtics/dashboard`.

## Extend

`defineConnector` and `defineWidget` are the extension points. See `examples/custom-connector.ts` and `examples/custom-widget.tsx`.
